changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO parser ( list_provider_id, source_id, name, description, dataset_name, plugin_id, plugin_url, data_source_type, parser_kind, source_location, parameters, refresh_hours, retention_months, licence, attribution, enabled, created_at ) SELECT p.id, NULL, 'PEP Luxembourg – Famille des PEP (Wikidata)', 'Conjoint, enfants, parents, frères et sœurs vivants des PEP luxembourgeois connus de Wikidata (catégorie LU-RCA)', 'lu_pep_rca', 'lu-pep-rca', 'D:/test parser 2/plugins/swiftcheck-aml-lu-pep-rca-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar', 'PLUGIN_MANAGED', 'SPARQL', NULL, '{"endpoint": "https://query.wikidata.org/sparql", "yearsAfterEnd": "5", "country": "Q32", "extraPositions": "Q29639349", "excludedPositions": "Q13102207 Q60853309"}', 168, 12, 'CC0 1.0 (Wikidata)', 'Wikidata, www.wikidata.org', TRUE, NOW() FROM list_provider p WHERE p.code = 'WIKIDATA';
INSERT INTO parser_coverage (parser_id, function_id) SELECT p.id, f.id FROM parser p JOIN pep_function f ON f.label = 'Membre de la famille d''une PEP' JOIN pep_category c ON c.id = f.category_id AND c.code = 'LU-RCA' WHERE p.dataset_name = 'lu_pep_rca';
